title: trichinium helichrysoides
intro: Trichinium helichrysoides, commonly known as Helichrysum cymosum or Trichinium helichrysoides, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, and it has been reported to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Trichinium helichrysoides include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions also include immune system modulation and potential anti-cancer properties, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and modern research.
